consequences.content: Rumors are spreading online about the disbanded group. Some fans are supportive, others are cruel.
An anonymous account is posting 'insider information' about what really happened. It's getting attention.
The landlord is asking about next month's rent. We need to figure something out.
Utility bill arrived. It's higher than expected.
A local café is looking for live music on weekends. It could be good practice and some cash.
An old fan reached out offering to help with a crowdfunding campaign.
A dance studio is offering free practice time in exchange for help cleaning up.
Yuseong has been seen near the apartment. He's watching.
A reporter called. They know where we live.
A fan sent a care package with food and supportive letters. It brightens everyone's day.
The group had a moment of genuine laughter today. It felt like old times.
Someone recognized us on the street and asked for a photo. For the first time, it felt good.
